evidence: Cic. Fam. 16.4.1: plānē cūrātiōnēs ejus nōn probō
terms.comment: With the genitive of the illness (Traupman 66). To treat a patient or an illness: cūrāre (Traupman 66, 397); Lewis & Short call the medical sense very frequent.
Also the art of medicine (see medicine).

phrases.latin: sed plānē cūrātiōnēs ejus nōn probō
phrases.english: but I really do not approve of his treatment

phrases.latin: prīncipiīs obstā; sērō medicīna parātur, cum mala per longās convaluēre morās
phrases.english: resist at the start: treatment comes too late when the trouble has grown strong through long delay

sources: Lewis & Short: curatio · Lewis & Short: cura · Lewis & Short: medicina
